subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR so this source-reproducible cron stagger bug can land in a maintainer-editable branch?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but the current closing PR is outside the target repository, unmerged, unstable, and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not start a competing fix lane until maintainers decide how to handle that candidate.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fix
options.body: Create or sponsor a maintainer-editable narrow PR that keeps the useful minute-zero parsing behavior and closes this issue after merge.

options.title: Review the existing fork PR
options.body: Proceed with the linked fork PR as the source of truth if maintainers are comfortable with its ownership, proof, and merge path.

options.title: Reject the expanded stagger semantics
options.body: If the intended product contract is literal minute `0` only, close this issue and the linked candidate with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the fix
recommendation.body: Create or sponsor a maintainer-editable narrow PR that keeps the useful minute-zero parsing behavior and closes this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The default stagger helper and service integration appear to originate from steipete's cron stagger commit, making him the strongest routing candidate for the ownership decision.
